description: Piesi i rowerzyści ranni w kolizjach i wypadkach komunikacyjnych w latach 2014 - 2026 is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia. Zestawienie zawiera informacje o liczbie pacjentów i liczbie świadczeń udzielonych osobom rannym w wybranych wypadkach komunikacyjnych (kod ICD-10: V01, V02, V10-V19) w okresie od stycznia 2014 roku do kwietnia 2026 roku. Coverage: Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia. The publisher named on the listing is Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia. Its keywords include Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia, wypadki komunikacyjne, wypadki z udziałem hulajnóg i rowerów, nfz, wypadki, wypadki rowerzystów. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2026-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
